item.text:
**8B.5 Research Note**

Overall reading: **mixed, leaning yes on operational follow-through in selected sectors, but not on a clean, whole-of-state discipline picture**. AMLO’s 2024 government showed real coordination in disasters, welfare delivery, and some enforcement, but the same year also featured heavy militarization, weak transparency oversight, and coercive/security-force failures.

### Positive evidence
| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Autoridades de los tres órdenes de gobierno coordinan acciones de apoyo en Guerrero y Oaxaca ante los efectos del huracán John](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/autoridades-de-los-tres-ordenes-de-gobierno-coordinan-acciones-de-apoyo-en-guerrero-y-oaxaca-ante-los-efectos-del-huracan-john) | Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana | 2024-09-24 | https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/autoridades-de-los-tres-ordenes-de-gobierno-coordinan-acciones-de-apoyo-en-guerrero-y-oaxaca-ante-los-efectos-del-huracan-john | Strong evidence of cross-ministry, federal-state-municipal coordination: Sedena, Marina, GN, CFE, Conagua, and state authorities were all mobilized in one response structure for Hurricane John. | 8B.5; 8B.4 |
| [CNPC participa en el informe general de acciones de atención y reconstrucción por el huracán John en Acapulco, Guerrero](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/cnpc-participa-en-el-informe-general-de-acciones-de-atencion-y-reconstruccion-por-el-huracan-john-en-acapulco-guerrero?idiom=es) | Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana | 2024-10-27 | https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/cnpc-participa-en-el-informe-general-de-acciones-de-atencion-y-reconstruccion-por-el-huracan-john-en-acapulco-guerrero?idiom=es | Follow-through looks real here: the federal emergency system reported 39 early-warning bulletins and a 22,683-person intergovernmental task force for response and evacuation. | 8B.5; 8B.3 |
| [IMSS-Bienestar opera en 23 entidades para atender a 53.2 millones de mexicanos que no tienen seguridad social](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170) | IMSS | 2024-04-17 | https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170 | Large-scale health rollout was operationalized through a nationwide system with defined staffing, facilities, and basification of health workers, indicating real bureaucratic coordination and implementation. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3; 8B.2 |
| [Banco del Bienestar suma 26.5 millones de cuentas por Programas para el Bienestar](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/banco-del-bienestar-distribuye-26-5-millones-de-tarjetas-para-pago-de-pensiones-becas-y-apoyos-del-gobierno-de-la-4t/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-05 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/banco-del-bienestar-distribuye-26-5-millones-de-tarjetas-para-pago-de-pensiones-becas-y-apoyos-del-gobierno-de-la-4t/ | The welfare system was using direct-payment infrastructure at very large scale, which is evidence of administrative discipline and delivery capacity rather than improvisation. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3; 8B.2 |
| [Tarjetas del Bienestar no se renovarán con cambio de administración](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/tarjeta-del-banco-del-bienestar-no-caigas-en-fraudes-no-hay-campanas-de-renovacion/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-09-10 | https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/tarjeta-del-banco-del-bienestar-no-caigas-en-fraudes-no-hay-campanas-de-renovacion/ | The outgoing government explicitly planned continuity across the transition, telling beneficiaries cards would remain valid and payments would continue normally. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3 |
| [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/ | AMLO backed a concrete enforcement case against a politically connected company, which shows some ability to mobilize the fiscal apparatus toward a defined anti-privilege goal. | 8B.5; 8B.4 |
| [Presidente López Obrador y virtual presidenta electa Sheinbaum alistan transición y reformas para continuar la 4T](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-lopez-obrador-y-virtual-presidenta-electa-sheinbaum-alistan-transicion-y-reformas-para-continuar-la-4t/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-10 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-lopez-obrador-y-virtual-presidenta-electa-sheinbaum-alistan-transicion-y-reformas-para-continuar-la-4t/ | The handoff to Sheinbaum was formalized publicly, which supports a claim of coordinated end-of-term control rather than organizational free-fall. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.1 |

### Negative evidence
| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico | HRW says AMLO transferred hundreds of government tasks to the military, limiting transparency and weakening civilian administrative control. That is negative evidence on disciplined, accountable coordination. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3; 8B.2 |
| [México: cambios constitucionales propuestos amenazan los derechos humanos](https://www.hrw.org/es/news/2024/08/30/mexico-cambios-constitucionales-propuestos-amenazan-los-derechos-humanos) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | https://www.hrw.org/es/news/2024/08/30/mexico-cambios-constitucionales-propuestos-amenazan-los-derechos-humanos | HRW warned the reform package would weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and reduce civilian oversight. That cuts against a clean internal-discipline story. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3 |
| [Mexican senators push through reform to boost military control over security](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-senators-push-through-reform-to-boost-military-control-over-security-3632396) | Reuters | 2024-09-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-senators-push-through-reform-to-boost-military-control-over-security-3632396 | The government shifted law-and-order power toward the armed forces, which suggests control was being centralized in a coercive bloc rather than disciplined through civilian institutions. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3 |
| [Mexico military's role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-3665909) | Reuters | 2024-10-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-3665909 | Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants and the military account was disputed, which is direct negative evidence that the security apparatus was not tightly controlled. | 8B.5; 8B.3 |
| [Judicial strikes grow in Mexico over reform pushing currency lower](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/judicial-strikes-grow-in-mexico-over-reform-pushing-currency-lower-3581911) | Reuters | 2024-08-21 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/judicial-strikes-grow-in-mexico-over-reform-pushing-currency-lower-3581911 | Judicial strikes and protests escalated as AMLO pressed the reform, suggesting poor coordination with a major institutional bloc and weak conflict management. | 8B.5; 8B.3; 8B.4 |
| [Evita fraudes: no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/ | The government admitted January-February payments were advanced before the blackout period, which is evidence of election-sensitive, patronage-adjacent timing rather than neutral administrative discipline. | 8B.5; 8B.4; 8B.3 |
| [World Report 2025: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2025 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/mexico | HRW says the military’s domestic role remained very large and civilian oversight remained limited. Although 2025, it reinforces the 2024 pattern of weak control over coercive institutions. | 8B.5; 8B.3; 8B.4 |

### Synthesis
AMLO’s 2024 record shows **real coordination in select operational domains**:
- disaster response,
- welfare delivery,
- health-system rollout,
- tax enforcement,
- and the Sheinbaum transition.

But the broader pattern is **not cleanly disciplined or civilian-controlled**:
- the military absorbed more functions,
- the judiciary and transparency watchdog were weakened,
- protest and journalistic scrutiny were often met with hostility,
- and the security apparatus still produced lethal abuses.

### Search gap
I found strong evidence for sectoral follow-through, but **no independent 2024 audit of whole-of-government internal discipline** across ministries and regions. Most positive evidence is either official self-reporting or issue-specific. That limits confidence on the strongest version of 8B.5.
